fieldValues.title: Story
fieldValues.moved_by: the session agent, from the owner's own words
fieldValues.needs: the owner's words, verbatim, one Tier-0 vignette per thought in srs-programme's Narrative explorations (`80b283ef`), under the conversation's note, tagged `vignette` and `topic:<slug>`
fieldValues.theory: All problems and domains evolve from stories (owner, 2026-10-25). The method is the chapter *Narrative explorations: how meaning grows*. Vignettes are collated by conversation (the note) and by topic across sessions (the tag).
gaps: No clerk command captures a vignette or lists them by conversation and topic; agents use `srs note create` (clerk#199).
fieldValues.evidence: owner, 2026-10-25, verbatim in srs-programme Narrative explorations (note 71d4c10a); clerk#197 run reports
